mcnemar_test.assumptions: Paired nominal 2x2 data; independent bernoulli trials across disjoint network components.

evidentiary_soundness_audit.operational_definition: A positive relationship prediction is evidentially sound if and only if it is supported by at least one verified PoliceIncidentReport documenting a solved burglary case with joint suspect participation within the evaluation window. Predictions made from CallDetailRecord (CDR) wiretap logs alone or unresolved street aliases are designated evidentially unsound.
evidentiary_soundness_audit.missing_evidence_condition_finding: In missing_evidence positive cases (N=20), the primary joint burglary report is omitted. System A infers 'Supported' based on circumstantial wiretap CDRs alone, achieving label accuracy 0.88 but evidentiary soundness 0.20. System B strictly requires documented solved burglary evidence, returning 'Insufficient Evidence' with evidentiary soundness 1.00.
